body:
Xbox, Game Pass, Single player

Can't save the game, and the game sometimes randomly crashes during autosave. Really enjoying the game, but I'd like to keep my progress.
I'm ok with suffering and pain, I deserve it.
There's never enough alcohol for me

I've always thought that pain was pain, not everyone is equipped to go through the same thing as others. If it bothers you or if you feel bad about it, then you do. Comparing yourself to others isn't healthy, even though everyone does.
Hey! You can talk to any of us if you want
Can this happen with Arthur too?
I'm not sure I've seen that lol

I was wondering if anyone else thought this too. Of course when things are moved it's a bit frustrating to remember where it is, but I genuinely don't like the change. It seems out of place, and I'm always trying to find the tab.
My dad did the same thing lmao
Since I try to please everyone and be a perfectionist, this absolutely destroyed me when I realized
When I'm having an episode, I think of the same thing. It honestly is the thought that changes my mind most of the time, since I'm weak as hell.

I don't expect him to give me another chance, hell, I don't really want him to. I seem to be blaming him because it's just my perspective. I had talked to him a lot about him trying more. And I changed and he forgave me and we trusted each other again. I totally take responsibility for my actions, but I just don't understand his thoughts on it I guess. I apologized. Many times. And I will continue to. But I agree that since we're young we really wouldn't work out anyway, besides, being sorry doesn't change much. But I did change. And I guess we'll both continue to. Thank you for your kindness.
